```diff
-    "vue3-virtual-scroller": "^2.0.3",   <- HEAD (already committed)
+    "vue3-virtual-scroller": "^0.2.3",   <- working tree (uncommitted, must stay out)
```

So after the 13:00Z commit:

- ✅ `git show --stat HEAD` must list **exactly 3 paths**: `src/api/modules/efforts.js`, `src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue`, `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`.
- ✅ `git diff HEAD -- package.json` **WILL still show the `^0.2.3` line**. That is the *expected* result — it proves the downgrade stayed out. It is **not** a failure.
- ❌ Do **not** report "package.json still dirty → fail". The old acceptance line `git diff HEAD -- package.json  # must stay EMPTY` on `0bc8b144` was withdrawn today for exactly this reason.
- ❌ Do **not** report the test file as "added" — `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` is `M` (+3/-5) against HEAD, the 9-case suite is already committed.

Everything else on this card stands: verify nothing extra entered the commit (no `TaskSettings.vue`, no `browsers.js`/`computers.js`, no `tests/voice*.test.mjs`, no `tests/responseOptions.test.mjs`). **`project_changes(scope="staged")` returned 102 staged files, +10273/-52 — all `.codx/` control-plane churn.** The commit must use the pathspec form (`git commit -m "…" -- <3 paths>`). If the executor instead ran a bare `git commit`, those 102 files are now in `HEAD`.

```
git show --name-only --format="" HEAD | grep -c '^\.codx/'     # must print 0
git show --stat HEAD                                             # must be 3 files, +19/-9
```

**This check is the one that fails loudest and quietest at the same time:** a commit that swept `.codx/` still lists the 3 right paths among 100+ others, so a naive "are the 3 paths there?" test passes. Count the total, not the presence.
